# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: multi-tier-app
description: A Helm chart for a multi-tier application with frontend, backend, and PostgreSQL
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 2

image:
  repository: nginx
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

frontend:
  name: frontend
  image:
    repository: nginx
    tag: alpine
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 80
  config:
    APP_ENV: production
    APP_DEBUG: "false"
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 256Mi

backend:
  name: backend
  image:
    repository: node
    tag: 18-alpine
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 3000
  config:
    DB_HOST: postgres
    DB_PORT: "5432"
    DB_NAME: appdb
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 256Mi

postgresql:
  name: postgres
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: 15-alpine
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 5432
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
    storageClass: standard
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 1000m
      memory: 1Gi
    requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi

secrets:
  postgres:
    POSTGRES_USER: appuser
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: changeme
    POSTGRES_DB: appdb
  backend:
    DB_USER: appuser
    DB_PASSWORD: changeme
    JWT_SECRET: my-jwt-secret-key

serviceAccount:
  create: true
  name: ""

ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  annotations: {}
  hosts:
    - host: chart-example.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: ImplementationSpecific
  tls: []

resources: {}
nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "multi-tier-app.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "multi-tier-app.name" . }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}
{{ include "multi-tier-app.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.serviceAccountName" -}}
{{- if .Values.serviceAccount.create }}
{{- default (include "multi-tier-app.fullname" .) .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
{{- else }}
{{- default "default" .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/frontend-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.fullname" . }}-frontend
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "multi-tier-app.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "multi-tier-app.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ include "multi-tier-app.serviceAccountName" . }}
      containers:
        - name: {{ .Values.frontend.name }}
          image: "{{ .Values.frontend.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.frontend.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.frontend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.frontend.service.port }}
              name: http
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.fullname" . }}-frontend-config
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.frontend.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/backend-deployment.yaml

  labels:

            - secretRef:

            {{- toYaml .Values.backend.resources | nindent 12 }}
